title: Shareholder registers
definition: The statutory register of members of a company, showing who holds the shares and since when. It is requested where the ownership of a company customer is in question, and it establishes the shareholders of record, which is not the same thing as the beneficial owners.
evidence_to_cite: the register, with the date of extraction
the shareholders and their holdings, and the dates of acquisition
any transfers during the period, and the consideration recorded

sources.citation: Ownership evidence for legal entity customers, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
